transcript: The fastest way to lower your stress is to stop trying to control or change anyone else, and let people be exactly who they are. Let them think what they think, do what they do, say what they say, and feel what they feel. Instead of pouring your energy outward, return it inward to your breath, to your thoughts, to your own actions, and to your own heart. The less you try to control others, the more at peace you become with yourself. Because let's be honest my friends, one of the biggest sources of stress in this world is other people. People can be loud, unkind, reactive, full of expectations, guilt and opinions that were never meant for you to carry. One of the greatest freedoms in life is realizing you no longer need to fight their storms. Just let them. Let them be who they've always been. Let them speak from their own wounds. Let them live inside their own patterns, especially family. Your family has been the same since the day you were born, so why exhaust your spirit hoping they will suddenly become someone else? You cannot change another person. People only change when their own soul is ready. But you, you can choose peace today. You can choose to release what is not yours. You can choose to breathe, soften, and return home to yourself. And if this message resonated with you, comment, stress, and I'll send you my free guide on simple, practical ways to reduce it and come back to calm. Follow for more reminders like this.
